framing.unit: one note event represented as one horizontal bar
framing.ordering: left-to-right onset time; lower-to-higher MIDI pitch vertically
framing.termination: the visual playhead reaches the right boundary and the audio tail ends
framing.synchronization: visual time and synthesized audio share the MRM tempo map

channels.semantics: equal-tempered sine-dominant tones; pitch follows MIDI pitch and amplitude follows velocity
bar x-position/width encode onset/duration, row encodes MIDI pitch, and brightness encodes velocity
identifies versions, inputs, artifacts, hashes, challenge, and evaluation status

symbols.meaning: silence when no note bar intersects the interval

bootstrap.self_identification: IAMP / transmission ID and MRM-000 · CP-000 are displayed in the canonical video

response.submission_instructions: Return one receiver-response-000 JSON object and preserve uncertainty without consulting withheld ground truth.

limitations: The baseline directly exposes MIDI pitch labels and is designed for measurement rather than compression.
Font and codec implementations can prevent byte-identical video across platforms.
This protocol communicates reference events; it does not assert a musical interpretation.
